# 6 Beast Summoner Combo

This is a combo comp, not a stat-check. Magnus opens the round by charging into the biggest enemy clump and AoE-stunning them, and Arc Warden clones him — with two or three Magnus copies stunning on entry, most fights are decided before they start. While the enemy is locked down, your summoners (Lone Druid, Warlock) flood the board with bears and golems, and the six-Beast trait makes every one of those summons stack a physical-damage-taken debuff on whatever they hit (up to 10 stacks). Add the Necronomicon — which secretly gives summoners an extra summon — and you overwhelm the board with units that both stun and shred.

> **Terminology note:** the video calls this comp "Savages," but there is no Savage synergy in this game. Mechanically it maps to **Beast**: the six-Beast trait is exactly the stacking physical-damage-taken debuff (applied by summoned units) the creator describes, and the whole build is a summoner comp. This guide uses Beast throughout.

## Core Units

| Unit | Cost | Synergies | Role |
|------|------|-----------|------|
| Magnus | 4 | Assassin, Centaur | Stun engine — charges + AoE stuns, cloned by Arc Warden |
| Arc Warden | 5 | Kobold, Shaman | Duplicates a matching unit (Magnus / Lone Druid) at fight start |
| Lone Druid | 4 | Beast, Druid | Summoner carry, three-star target, takes Necronomicon |
| Warlock | 5 | Orc, Warlock | Golem summoner, best home for Necronomicon + Refresher |
| Lycan | 3 | Beast, Human, Hunter | Wolves + a durable Beast body |
| Primal Beast | 5 | Beast, Warrior | Extra stuns, huge Beast body |
| Monkey King | 4 | Beast, Monk | More stun coverage |
| Enchantress | 1 | Beast, Centaur, Druid | Cheap Beast + a Centaur for the stampede stun |
| Centaur Warrunner | 2 | Centaur, Warrior | Extra Centaur so pieces charge-stun on entry |
| Tusk | 1 | Beast, Warrior | Cheap sixth Beast |

Your six Beasts (Lone Druid, Lycan, Primal Beast, Monkey King, Enchantress, Tusk) turn on the debuff; Magnus, Enchantress and Centaur Warrunner supply the Centaur charge-stun.

## Items

- **Magnus** wants Minotaur Horn (tier 4) so his charge lands the opening AoE stun immediately — this is the item the whole combo is built around.
- **Warlock (or Lone Druid)** carries Necronomicon (tier 4). It reads as "summon two necro-crypts," but the hidden effect is that any summoner holding it summons one extra unit — so Lone Druid's bear becomes two, Warlock's golems double up.
- Add **Refresher Orb (tier 4)** to the Warlock so every activated item and his ultimate fire twice — double golems, double Necronomicon, double Gleipnir.
- **Gleipnir (tier 4)** (the "glimmer") both roots enemies and, as a damaging item, instantly tops up the Warlock's mana so he casts on contact.

## Relics

- **Dungeon Master Key** — lets you freely re-choose which units you ban, so you can swap from banning Humans early to banning legendaries late for better hit rates.
- **Certainty Loop / streak protection** — don't select it the moment it appears; hold the relic box open and only pick it on the round you're about to break your streak, so the protection stretches ~10 rounds further.

## Leveling / Roll Plan

- **Early:** Play a Warrior or Priest streak (win or lose) to build economy — this comp is a transition, not an opener.
- **Level 9 (round ~21):** Roll here, not at 8 — you need the purple/legendary rate. Ban Humans for the best rate (you lose Lycan access, so secure a two-star Lycan first) or ban Goblins as the cheaper option.
- **Assembling the combo:** Get Magnus to two-star, find Arc Warden, and pick up a summoner (Lone Druid or Warlock). Push level 10 after round 30 for a second Magnus and more summon bodies.

## Positioning / Matchup Notes

Split the Magnus copies to opposite edges so they charge across the board and stun the widest area. Leave open space next to Arc Warden so his clones have room to spawn, and don't cluster him against a wall. Keep the summoners protected behind the front so their armies come out uninterrupted.

The combo beats essentially every comp that can be stunned or debuffed — the perma-stun plus stacking physical amp overwhelms warriors, mages and other carries. Its one hard counter is **Faceless (Void)**: those units are immune to stuns and debuffs, so your control and your six-Beast amp both do nothing. Against Faceless you need a different plan (raw damage), because the combo simply won't function.
